This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
LOWERED from 85 -> 60 -> 45 (the pristine TT default): 60% still wasn't enough -- DPL-0036 moved
one step earlier in the flow, to RepairDesignPostGPL (buffer insertion right after global
placement, before CTS even runs), which means the floorplan simply has no open area for the
repair passes anywhere, not just at the hold-fix stage. If GPL-0302 (placement too sparse)
shows up at 45%, raise in small steps (50, 55...) rather than jumping back toward 60+.
GPL_CELL_PADDING / DPL_CELL_PADDING - raised from 2 -> 3 (pristine TT default is 2; going one
step higher since even 60% density + padding 2 still wasn't enough room for repair buffers).
These leave gaps around cells during global/detailed placement so later stages (fanout/cap
repair, hold-fix buffers, CTS) have somewhere legal to land without rerunning placement.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Set to 100ns (10MHz) to match the SCL/clk ratio assumed in docs/info.md -- revert to 20 if you'd rather run at 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
LOWERED slightly from 0.1/0.05 -> 0.08/0.04: tighter margins mean the resizer inserts fewer
hold buffers in the first place (you had 4216, which is what overwhelmed placement at 85%
density). If real-silicon hold margin turns out too thin after this, raise these back up
before lowering PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT further -- don't fight the symptom in two places at once.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
